Item: How will the lid be controlled through its full travel?
Prompt / specification: A heavy lid changes leverage as it opens and can pinch fingers or strike the wall. Options: Use tested lid supports matched to weight and geometry | Use a divided or lighter lid | Rely on friction hinges without a weight check

The top panel alone should not bridge a long storage opening without a defined support path. Options: Transfer load through ends, dividers, and a front/back rail system | Add a centered divider under the longest span | Increase finish thickness on an unsupported lid

Tall backs, open lids, children climbing, and uneven floors can shift the center of mass. Options: Evaluate tip and slide behavior, then anchor where needed | Use a wide plinth and non-slip feet for a low freestanding bench | Assume stored weight prevents movement
Fit the bench to users, contents, room surfaces, and the complete lid movement.
